---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

Describe the problem or gap that this feature would address. What is currently missing or broken?

## Why it matters

Explain the value of this feature. Who benefits from it and how does it improve the project?

## Suggested Fix

Describe the proposed implementation or approach. Include any relevant technical details, mockups, or references.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] Feature is implemented
- [ ] Tests are added or updated
- [ ] All CI checks pass locally (`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test`, `npm run build`)
- [ ] PR links to this issue (e.g., `Closes #<issue-number>`)
